name: Costly Menace
summary: In Southshore, Darren Malvew fears the mountain lions descending from Alterac. Undead, the Syndicate gang, and other scoundrels have cost the town horses, but the lions trouble him most.

sections.title: Horses Lost
sections.body: Darren Malvew lives in Southshore and hates seeing the town lose its beautiful horses. Undead, the Syndicate gang, and other scoundrels in the region have already taken quite a few. Yet Darren fears the mountain lions of Alterac most. They keep coming down from the hills.

sections.title: Lions of the Hills
sections.body: Darren wants eight Mountain Lions and ten Hulking Mountain Lions dealt with. The Mountain Lions roam the lower hills of the Alterac Mountains.

faq.answer: Darren Malvew lives in Southshore, in Hillsbrad Foothills, and is tired of losing the town's horses.

faq.q: Where are the mountain lions coming from?
faq.answer: The mountain lions come down from the hills of Alterac. Mountain Lions roam the lower hills of the Alterac Mountains.

faq.q: What threats to the horses does Darren mention?
faq.answer: Undead, the Syndicate gang, and other scoundrels in the region have cost Southshore horses. Darren says the mountain lions of Alterac are the greatest threat.

faq.q: What specific beasts need to be culled?
faq.answer: Eight Mountain Lions and ten Hulking Mountain Lions, as Darren asks.
